<!--
  The head of an inner page with breadcrumbs. Axes: aside (none, figure: one large figure such as a count or a
  total, note: a small card with a glyph such as a delivery promise or a document version, facts: four key facts
  in two columns), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { PageExtras } from "./page-trail.types";
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";

export type PageTrailProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  label: string;
  crumbs: NavLink[];
  extras: PageExtras;
  aside?: "none" | "figure" | "note" | "facts";
  level?: 1 | 2;
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import PageAside from "../components/page-aside.vue";
import PageCrumbs from "../components/page-crumbs.vue";
import SectionHeader from "../components/section-header.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  label,
  crumbs,
  extras,
  aside = "none",
  level = 1,
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<PageTrailProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="cn('py-8', (((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : ''))"
    :aria-labelledby="titleId"
    data-testid="section"
    :data-tone="tone"
    :data-aside="aside"
  >
    <Container :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'flex flex-col gap-6')" data-slot="container">
      <PageCrumbs :label="label" :crumbs="crumbs" />
      <Box
        :class="
          (aside as string) === 'facts' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2'
          : 'flex flex-col gap-6 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between'
        "
      >
        <Stack gap="4" align="start" class="min-w-0">
          <SectionHeader :titleId="titleId" :title="title" :heading="{ level, badge }" :lead="lead" />
        </Stack>
        <PageAside v-if="((aside as string) !== 'none')" :extras="extras" :mode="aside" />
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
